description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Nocache_Insert class, which is a plugin used to compile the {insert} tag into cached PHP code within the Smarty templating system. It facilitates dynamic content insertion in templates with caching support.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Nocache_Insert
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling the {insert} tag into PHP code in Smarty's caching mechanism.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Static method that generates PHP code for the {insert} Smarty tag, handling script inclusion and variable assignment, designed for caching purposes.
